project_overview.description: Premium artisanal South Indian sugarcane panakam e-commerce marketing site.

rules: H1 must be fluid clamp(3rem, 8vw, 5rem) with leading-none and tracking-tighter.
Overlines must be uppercase, text-xs or text-sm, tracking-[0.2em].
No Inter or generic fonts for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond for an editorial feel.
No pure black (#000000) or pure white. Use tinted dark greens (#0A100C) for backgrounds.
Avoid large solid areas of bright orange; use jaggery amber (#C86A23) for accents, buttons, and text highlights.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all readable text.
Do NOT use teal green or teal blue.

grid_modes.marketing: Mode A: The Tetris Grid (gap-8 to gap-12, asymmetrical spans).
grid_modes.products: Mode A variant with 1px borders and heavy padding.

rules: Use p-12, p-20, or p-32 for section padding.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-8 minimum).
Never center everything; create tension with left-aligned large blocks balanced by negative space.
Ensure direct children are used in grid layouts.

surfaces_and_borders.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A100C]/70 border-b border-[#213827].
surfaces_and_borders.cards: Solid flat background (muted) or 1px subtle border (#213827) with no shadow.
rules: No transparent dropdowns or overlays where content overlaps. The header must have a backdrop blur.
Hover states should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and brighten borders/text.
Buttons should be sharp rectangular or slight pill-shape.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: MANDATORY: Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.reveals: Line-by-line masked text reveals for H1 and story manifesto using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Buttons and links must explicitly set hover:text-color and hover:bg-color.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow, organic editorial marquee (Cormorant Garamond, pale background, dark text, gap-24).

3d_strategy.scene: Sugarcane field abstract scene with a central product glass/bottle.
implementation: Use <Canvas> with <Environment preset='sunset'> for warm realistic lighting mimicking dawn/dusk.
Float the main product representation using <Float>.
Create stylized sugarcane stalks in the background (using simple Cylinder/Box geometries with greenish materials) to mimic a field without needing complex custom models.
Use a transparent background (rgba(0,0,0,0)) so the 3D canvas blends with the dark UI underneath.
Wrap in <Suspense> with an aesthetic text-based fallback loader.

home.hero: 3D Scene full screen (R3F sugarcane field + glass). Kinetic masked headline overlapping. Lenis scroll setup.
home.marquee: Editorial ribbon dividing hero from content ('100% Pure Cane • Handcrafted Jaggery • South Indian Heritage').
home.story_preview: Bento layout with jaggery making image, brief manifesto snippet, and 'Read Story' link.
home.product_spotlight: Large image of copper pour, 1px border cards showcasing 2-3 panakam variants.

story.hero: Large typography driven hero, minimal imagery, heavy text reveal.
story.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) flowing asymmetrically. Alternating text blocks and imagery (Sugarcane field, traditional craft).

products.layout: Grid of 1px border cards. E-commerce focused but artful. 2 or 3 column bento grid.
products.card_design: Minimalist, flat muted bg, high contrast 'Add to Order' button.

contact.layout: 2-column layout. Left: Large atmospheric image (jaggery liquid). Right: Enquiry form.
contact.form: Shadcn based. Fields for Name, Phone, Quantity, Message. Styled with dark borders and earthy focus rings. Submit saves to FastAPI/MongoDB backend.

components.styling: Override Shadcn defaults. Remove generic gray borders; use #213827. Ensure all JS files are .js (not .tsx).

images.description: Tall green sugarcane field under a clear blue sky. Use for story section background or wide banners.
Copper kettle pouring traditional Indian drink. Ideal for product presentation.
Crystal glass filled with amber-colored liquid. Great for atmospheric shots or contact form side image.
Man creating jaggery outdoors. Perfect for heritage and craftsmanship storytelling.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create artful asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, avoiding fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
Do not apply universal transitions (`transition: all`); add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do not center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g. p-16, p-24).
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-order-button').
Use Javascript (.jsx/.js) files exclusively for React components, no Typescript (.tsx/.ts).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for body text. Use APCA contrast principles.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings required on all form inputs and interactive elements.
